title: Climate Targets & Projections
goal: Use futuro perfecto with para cuando + subjunctive, passive se and probability estimates in climate-policy prose.

items: I can pair *para cuando* + present subjunctive with *futuro perfecto* to state future policy milestones.
I can use passive *se* in the future perfect and epistemic *habrá* + participle for probable recent trends.
I can use core vocabulary for emissions, climate neutrality, energy transition, efficiency and grid electrification.
